subject: Standardized residual covariance matrix with MLM?

messages.author: 96186c8156f24c0d
messages.subject: Standardized residual covariance matrix with MLM?
parts:
Hello!
Is there a way to obtain standardized residual covariance matrix with MLM?  I see, that it´s only possible with ML estimation at the moment and i wonder, if there is an alternative way to get them. Can i interpret the unstandardized parameters somehow, if i use std.ov=TRUE? Should i run my analysis with ML for the standardized residual CovMatrix and report, that i got these values with ML?

Thanks for any answers!

PS: By the way, i´m also using lavaan.survey for weighting.

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: Standardized residual covariance matrix with MLM?
parts:
On 10/05/2015 11:48 AM, Niels wrote:
> Hello!
> Is there a way to obtain standardized residual covariance matrix with
> MLM?

But what about:

example(cfa)
fit <- cfa(HS.model, data=HolzingerSwineford1939, estimator = "MLM")
resid(fit, "standardized")

This seems to work?

Yves.
